question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features for our products, official competitor documentation or third-party evidence for competitor claims, and avoid treating internal sales battle cards or sales language as binding technical facts [2][6].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| Formal R&S product specifications/features for CMX500, CMW500, CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06, because the CMX500-vs-amarisoft and CMX500-vs-Anritsu pages explicitly say battle-card pages cannot replace those formal documents [2][6]. | Internal comparison pages are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [1][5]. |
| For Signaling Tester claims, cite CMX500 formal sources: CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [10][11]. | CMX500 signaling and WLAN claims should be tied to the CMX500 specs/features sources, including listed signaling options such as WLAN signaling and NR/LTE signaling options [10][74]. |
| For Non-signaling / production-path claims, cite the formal product pages for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06: CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing [16][17]; CMP200 forms a 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution with remote radio heads [19][21]; CMW100 K06 is a Communications Manufacturing Test Set with RF generator/analyzer and production test specifications [24]. | The amarisoft battle card’s production-path comparison says the production platforms’ specifications must be cited from their own formal source pages [61]. |
| For competitor claims, use competitor official documents or third-party evidence; the amarisoft claims currently come only from an R&S internal battle card, and customer-facing use requires amarisoft official data and third-party evidence [2][7]. | The Anritsu battle-card claims likewise mainly come from an R&S internal battle card, and customer-facing use requires Anritsu official data and third-party evidence [6]. |
| For Anritsu MX844030PC, the Anritsu product brochure can support only MX844030PC-specific facts, such as that it is Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software, supports MAC-IF / PHY-IF Digital-IQ / RF-IF for RedCap, and uses common RTD GUI [46][49][67]. | That Anritsu brochure cannot verify R&S advantages over CMX500, and it does not provide MT8000A formal specifications [6][50]. |
| For MT8000A numerical claims such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz BW, 5 Gbps, or FR3 0.4–16 GHz, Anritsu official sources are required before quoting them to customers [38]. | The current MT8000A page records only R&S battle-card competitor descriptions and has not imported an Anritsu official datasheet [37]. |
| For amarisoft limitations such as “no global footprint,” “remote-only support,” “no Wi-Fi signaling,” and “no production/ATE testers,” amarisoft official sources or third-party sources are required [7]. | The amarisoft positioning and limitations are R&S sales-battle-card claims, not amarisoft official specifications or third-party market validation [69]. |
| For conformance, operator acceptance, PTCRB/GCF alignment, validated NTN, or Samsung-related claims, evidence must include test package option codes, accreditation/validation documents, Samsung validation reports, or test case lists, because the battle-card comparison notes those items are not provided [61]. | Internal RF/RRM and certification update sources are not official GCF/PTCRB/CTIA minutes and lack complete datasets, methodology, test case IDs, band combinations, or measurement criteria [26][29]. |
| For Wi-Fi signaling comparisons, cite CMX500 features/options for R&S claims and official competitor evidence for competitor claims; CMX500 features list WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, and CMX500 WLAN signaling options include 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO options [10][74]. | Battle-card statements that amarisoft lacks Wi-Fi signaling or that Anritsu needs a separate WLAN tester require external competitor confirmation before customer use [7][38][61]. |
| For FR3 / RFU18 / 6G-readiness comparisons, do not treat battle-card or PR claims as formal specifications; RFU18 and FR3 claims lack formal datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, software release, and measurement conditions [55][56][57]. | The FR3 13 GHz demonstration is PR/demonstration-level evidence and lacks hardware configuration, option code, throughput, bandwidth, MCS, modulation, channel model, calibration, and measurement uncertainty details [59][60]. |
| For TCO, fewer boxes, higher throughput, “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof,” “industry-leading,” or similar superiority language, do not present it as verified technical fact unless backed by a documented dataset or calculation; these phrases are identified as sales language or unsupported sales messages [2][6][65]. | The Anritsu battle card’s “fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput” message has no TCO calculation in the source [65]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible comparison needs side-by-side, source-level evidence: formal R&S specs/options for our Signaling and Non-signaling Tester capabilities, official competitor specs or third-party validation for competitor capabilities and limits, and documented test conditions, option codes, versions, calibration/tolerance status, and validation records for every measurable claim [2][6][12][61].

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

amarisoft › unresolved
- 來源沒有引用 [[amarisoft]] 官方文件；所有資訊目前都來自 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]。
- 公司規模在同一來源中出現 **15–50** 與 **15–25** 兩種寫法。
- “up to 1000 UEs”、NB-IoT、LTE-M、RedCap、basic NTN 等能力缺少型號、軟體版本、SDR hardware 與測試條件。
- “no global footprint”、“remote-only support”、“no Wi-Fi signaling”、“no production/ATE testers” 等競品限制需另以 amarisoft 官方資料或第三方來源確認。

amarisoft › 產品線與架構
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Product lines：[[AMARI Callbox Series]]（Mini、Classic、Advanced、Ultimate、Extreme）與 [[UE Simbox Series]]。
- Architecture：software-defined RAN & Core，包括 eNB、gNB、EPC、5GC，running on x86 Linux + SDR。
- 來源稱其強項是 functional load testing、flexibility，以及最多 **1000 UEs**。
- 來源列出的支援 / 適用範圍包含 [[NB-IoT]]、[[LTE-M]]、[[RedCap]] 與 basic [[NTN]]，但未提供對應版本、型號或測試條件。

amarisoft
[[amarisoft]] 是一間來源描述為法國小型私人公司的 software-based [[4G]] / [[5G]] network stacks and test systems 供應商；目前本頁僅依 R&S internal battle card 記錄其在 [[R&S CMX500]] 競品比較中的定位。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 訂購資訊
| 項目 | Type | Order No. | 原文說明 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Wideband radio communication tester | R&S®CMW500 | 1201.0002K50 | Base unit accessories: power cord, operating manual (quick start guide) |

來源指出更多 available options 的 ordering information 需參考 product brochure PD 5214.2833.12 或 local Rohde & Schwarz expert；本 data sheet 未列完整 option order no.。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S CMP200 › Specifications data sheet
本頁硬體、IF、RRH、UWB head、ordering、mechanical、environmental 與 conformance 相關主張主要來自 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

- 文件名稱：**CMP200 Radio Communication Tester Specifications Data Sheet**。
- 文件代碼：**PD 5216.4391.22**。

- 既有 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 提到 Anritsu software ecosystem 中有 SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC，但未說明 MX844030PC 的正式產品定位、介面、configuration 或 ordering information。本來源是 Anritsu product brochure，補足 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的官方產品層資訊。
- 既有 [[Anritsu MT8000A]] 頁在 unresolved 中記錄 R&S battle card 未說明 MX844030PC 的版本、相依關係或正式產品名稱。本來源確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，並且 RTD 的說明需參照 [[Anritsu MT8000A]] catalog；但它仍未提供 MT8000A 正式規格。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with new [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to **20 Gbps**，supporting wide dynamic range、[[4096QAM]] 與 up to **16 device antenna ports**。
- 來源仍未提供 [[RFU18]] order number、formal specs 文件編號、bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software release 或 measurement conditions。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › CMX500 OBT 在來源中的角色
來源稱 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 是 future-proof multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester，且其 versatility allows for easy adaptation to different [[NR]] numerologies，因此適合 [[FR3]] research and development。

在此 demonstration 中，來源列出 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的兩個功能：

- Create a signaling environment by transmitting an [[FR3]] cell signal at 13 GHz, simulating real-world conditions。
- Conduct comprehensive analysis, verifying the device's ability to achieve maximum throughput in the [[FR3]] frequency range。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 與 RFU18 battle card 主張的關係
- [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 依 2026-02-26 battle cards 記錄 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz、max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz 等 sales claims，且明確說這些不能當作正式規格。
- 本頁來源是 PR / demonstration claim，提供 13 GHz demo 說法，但仍未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 hardware configuration、option code 或 measurement details。
- 本來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，因此不能用來確認 [[RFU18]] 參與此 13 GHz demo。
- 本來源能補強的是：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] PR 層級確實把 13 GHz [[5G NR]] demo 放在 proposed [[FR3]] / next-generation [[6G]] research context 中。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[RFU18]] 或 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 5G mobile test platform 的 formal specifications。
- 來源未提供 throughput 數值、bandwidth、subcarrier spacing、MCS index、modulation order、coding rate、TDD / FDD、MIMO layer count、conducted / radiated setup、channel model、calibration 或 measurement uncertainty。
- 來源未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 13 GHz 的 RF chain、external frontend、frequency converter、IF / RF unit、software version 或 license configuration。
- 來源未標示 published date；只能記錄 raw created 2026-09-11。
- 來源說 MWC 2025 will jointly showcase，未提供實際展出後測試結果。

| Wi-Fi signaling | [[R&S CMX500]] integrated Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 | external AP/N3IWF 或 no Wi-Fi signaling | Wi-Fi feature 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Legacy RF | [[R&S CMW500]] for 2G/3G continuity | [[Anritsu MT8821C]] needed even for most LTE cases | Anritsu LTE RF statement 未有官方文件佐證 |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]] / [[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMW100 K06]] | MT8000A + MD8475B + MT8821C + MT8870A + MT8862A separate ecosystems；另 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 補出 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 與 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] / [[MX819020A]] 的 virtual signalling path | source 未展開 MT8870A，也未提供完整 Anritsu production flow 文件 |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 與 Anritsu MX844030PC 官方 brochure 的關係
[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

⚠️ 來源 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）說 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 使用 common [[RTD]] GUI，讓 NR protocol test cases 可在 Post-Silicon 與 Pre-silicon phase 間移植，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 說 Anritsu software 為 SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC 的 fragmented / disconnected tools。判斷：官方 brochure 支撐 MX844030PC 與 RTD 有整合面；battle card 的 fragmented 判斷仍可作為 R&S sales positioning，但不得當作 Anritsu 官方規格描述。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Anritsu 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1、FR2、FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被描述為需要多 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes、external PC / tools 與 fragmented software ecosystem。

amarisoft › 來源中的競品定位
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[amarisoft]] 定位為 cost-efficient and flexible for functional testing，但列出以下限制：

- 缺少 calibrated RF。
- 缺少 conformance / operator acceptance assurance。
- 缺少 validated NTN。
- 缺少 global support、calibration labs、field service、SLAs。
- 缺少 instrument-class long warranty。
- FR2 依賴 external hardware / external RRH，來源以 “calibration?” 標示疑問。
- 缺少 2G/3G stack。

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features for our products, official competitor documentation or third-party evidence for competitor claims, and avoid treating internal sales battle cards or sales language as binding technical facts [2][6].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| Formal R&S product specifications/features for CMX500, CMW500, CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06, because the CMX500-vs-amarisoft and CMX500-vs-Anritsu pages explicitly say battle-card pages cannot replace those formal documents [2][6]. | Internal comparison pages are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [1][5]. |
| For Signaling Tester claims, cite CMX500 formal sources: CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [10][11]. | CMX500 signaling and WLAN claims should be tied to the CMX500 specs/features sources, including listed signaling options such as WLAN signaling and NR/LTE signaling options [10][74]. |
| For Non-signaling / production-path claims, cite the formal product pages for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06: CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing [16][17]; CMP200 forms a 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution with remote radio heads [19][21]; CMW100 K06 is a Communications Manufacturing Test Set with RF generator/analyzer and production test specifications [24]. | The amarisoft battle card’s production-path comparison says the production platforms’ specifications must be cited from their own formal source pages [61]. |
| For competitor claims, use competitor official documents or third-party evidence; the amarisoft claims currently come only from an R&S internal battle card, and customer-facing use requires amarisoft official data and third-party evidence [2][7]. | The Anritsu battle-card claims likewise mainly come from an R&S internal battle card, and customer-facing use requires Anritsu official data and third-party evidence [6]. |
| For Anritsu MX844030PC, the Anritsu product brochure can support only MX844030PC-specific facts, such as that it is Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software, supports MAC-IF / PHY-IF Digital-IQ / RF-IF for RedCap, and uses common RTD GUI [46][49][67]. | That Anritsu brochure cannot verify R&S advantages over CMX500, and it does not provide MT8000A formal specifications [6][50]. |
| For MT8000A numerical claims such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz BW, 5 Gbps, or FR3 0.4–16 GHz, Anritsu official sources are required before quoting them to customers [38]. | The current MT8000A page records only R&S battle-card competitor descriptions and has not imported an Anritsu official datasheet [37]. |
| For amarisoft limitations such as “no global footprint,” “remote-only support,” “no Wi-Fi signaling,” and “no production/ATE testers,” amarisoft official sources or third-party sources are required [7]. | The amarisoft positioning and limitations are R&S sales-battle-card claims, not amarisoft official specifications or third-party market validation [69]. |
| For conformance, operator acceptance, PTCRB/GCF alignment, validated NTN, or Samsung-related claims, evidence must include test package option codes, accreditation/validation documents, Samsung validation reports, or test case lists, because the battle-card comparison notes those items are not provided [61]. | Internal RF/RRM and certification update sources are not official GCF/PTCRB/CTIA minutes and lack complete datasets, methodology, test case IDs, band combinations, or measurement criteria [26][29]. |
| For Wi-Fi signaling comparisons, cite CMX500 features/options for R&S claims and official competitor evidence for competitor claims; CMX500 features list WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, and CMX500 WLAN signaling options include 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO options [10][74]. | Battle-card statements that amarisoft lacks Wi-Fi signaling or that Anritsu needs a separate WLAN tester require external competitor confirmation before customer use [7][38][61]. |
| For FR3 / RFU18 / 6G-readiness comparisons, do not treat battle-card or PR claims as formal specifications; RFU18 and FR3 claims lack formal datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, software release, and measurement conditions [55][56][57]. | The FR3 13 GHz demonstration is PR/demonstration-level evidence and lacks hardware configuration, option code, throughput, bandwidth, MCS, modulation, channel model, calibration, and measurement uncertainty details [59][60]. |
| For TCO, fewer boxes, higher throughput, “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof,” “industry-leading,” or similar superiority language, do not present it as verified technical fact unless backed by a documented dataset or calculation; these phrases are identified as sales language or unsupported sales messages [2][6][65]. | The Anritsu battle card’s “fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput” message has no TCO calculation in the source [65]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible comparison needs side-by-side, source-level evidence: formal R&S specs/options for our Signaling and Non-signaling Tester capabilities, official competitor specs or third-party validation for competitor capabilities and limits, and documented test conditions, option codes, versions, calibration/tolerance status, and validation records for every measurable claim [2][6][12][61].

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 與既有 CMX500 正式規格的差異
⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 [[R&S CMX500]] 在 FR2 有 **>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth** 與 **>10 Gbps data rate**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit bandwidth up to **1 GHz**、[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF bandwidth **250 MHz**，且 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 對 NR FR2 measurements 列 channel bandwidth **50 / 100 / 200 / 400 MHz**。判斷：battle card 數字不可當作 CMX500 binding specifications；引用時只能標示為 2026-02-26 sales claim，需等待正式 RFU18 / FR2 high-bandwidth 規格文件。

⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 quick comparison table 中 [[R&S CMX500]] FR1 bandwidth 為 **500 MHz (& future scalable)**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF generator RF bandwidth **250 MHz**、RF analyzer demodulation bandwidth **250 MHz**，而 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 說 RF unit 每個 RX 最高 **500 MHz bandwidth**、每個 TX 最高 **200 MHz total carrier bandwidth**。判斷：battle card 的 FR1 500 MHz 說法與正式規格口徑不同；報價、規格比較或承諾前需回查正式 CMX500 / RFU option 文件。

⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 quick comparison table 中 [[R&S CMX500]] cellular FR1 up to **18 GHz**、FR2 up to **50 GHz (RRH evo)**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit frequency range **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**，[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF generator **6 GHz to 20 GHz**、IF analyzer **4 GHz to 20 GHz**，FR2 remote radio heads 為 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]]。判斷：Keysight battle card 的 quick table 可能把 FR1 / FR3 / RFU18 roadmap 口徑混寫；正式規格比較不得直接引用 FR1 up to 18 GHz。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 與 RFU18 battle card 主張的關係
- [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 依 2026-02-26 battle cards 記錄 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz、max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz 等 sales claims，且明確說這些不能當作正式規格。
- 本頁來源是 PR / demonstration claim，提供 13 GHz demo 說法，但仍未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 hardware configuration、option code 或 measurement details。
- 本來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，因此不能用來確認 [[RFU18]] 參與此 13 GHz demo。
- 本來源能補強的是：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] PR 層級確實把 13 GHz [[5G NR]] demo 放在 proposed [[FR3]] / next-generation [[6G]] research context 中。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[RFU18]] 或 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 5G mobile test platform 的 formal specifications。
- 來源未提供 throughput 數值、bandwidth、subcarrier spacing、MCS index、modulation order、coding rate、TDD / FDD、MIMO layer count、conducted / radiated setup、channel model、calibration 或 measurement uncertainty。
- 來源未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 13 GHz 的 RF chain、external frontend、frequency converter、IF / RF unit、software version 或 license configuration。
- 來源未標示 published date；只能記錄 raw created 2026-09-11。
- 來源說 MWC 2025 will jointly showcase，未提供實際展出後測試結果。

| FR1 / FR2 | [[R&S CMX500]] covers FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz / calibrated FR2 | external RRH for FR2，calibration 以問號標示 | “up to 50 GHz” 為 battle card 說法；正式規格需引用 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] |
| Wi-Fi signaling | [[R&S CMX500]] integrated Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 | external AP/N3IWF 或 no Wi-Fi signaling | Wi-Fi feature 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance | PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests | functional only；not accepted for operator certification | 來源未列 test package option code 或 accreditation 文件 |

| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production / ATE / non-signaling path | no non-signaling platform、no production scaling path | 各 production platform 規格需分別引用其正式 source pages |
| Load / flexibility | battle card 主張 R&S validated testing | excellent functional load testing、up to 1000 UEs、flexible for NB-IoT / LTE-M / RedCap / basic NTN | amarisoft 能力缺少版本與硬體條件 |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 與 Anritsu MX844030PC 官方 brochure 的關係
[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

⚠️ 來源 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）說 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 使用 common [[RTD]] GUI，讓 NR protocol test cases 可在 Post-Silicon 與 Pre-silicon phase 間移植，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 說 Anritsu software 為 SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC 的 fragmented / disconnected tools。判斷：官方 brochure 支撐 MX844030PC 與 RTD 有整合面；battle card 的 fragmented 判斷仍可作為 R&S sales positioning，但不得當作 Anritsu 官方規格描述。

amarisoft › 來源中的競品定位
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[amarisoft]] 定位為 cost-efficient and flexible for functional testing，但列出以下限制：

- 缺少 calibrated RF。
- 缺少 conformance / operator acceptance assurance。
- 缺少 validated NTN。
- 缺少 global support、calibration labs、field service、SLAs。
- 缺少 instrument-class long warranty。
- FR2 依賴 external hardware / external RRH，來源以 “calibration?” 標示疑問。
- 缺少 2G/3G stack。
- 缺少 Wi-Fi signaling。
- 缺少 production / ATE testers 與 non-signaling factory-line path。

以上是 R&S sales battle card 的競品論述；不是 [[amarisoft]] 官方規格，也不是第三方市場驗證。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

amarisoft › unresolved
- 來源沒有引用 [[amarisoft]] 官方文件；所有資訊目前都來自 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]。
- 公司規模在同一來源中出現 **15–50** 與 **15–25** 兩種寫法。
- “up to 1000 UEs”、NB-IoT、LTE-M、RedCap、basic NTN 等能力缺少型號、軟體版本、SDR hardware 與測試條件。
- “no global footprint”、“remote-only support”、“no Wi-Fi signaling”、“no production/ATE testers” 等競品限制需另以 amarisoft 官方資料或第三方來源確認。

amarisoft › 產品線與架構
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Product lines：[[AMARI Callbox Series]]（Mini、Classic、Advanced、Ultimate、Extreme）與 [[UE Simbox Series]]。
- Architecture：software-defined RAN & Core，包括 eNB、gNB、EPC、5GC，running on x86 Linux + SDR。
- 來源稱其強項是 functional load testing、flexibility，以及最多 **1000 UEs**。
- 來源列出的支援 / 適用範圍包含 [[NB-IoT]]、[[LTE-M]]、[[RedCap]] 與 basic [[NTN]]，但未提供對應版本、型號或測試條件。

amarisoft
[[amarisoft]] 是一間來源描述為法國小型私人公司的 software-based [[4G]] / [[5G]] network stacks and test systems 供應商；目前本頁僅依 R&S internal battle card 記錄其在 [[R&S CMX500]] 競品比較中的定位。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

來源指出更多 available options 的 ordering information 需參考 product brochure PD 5214.2833.12 或 local Rohde & Schwarz expert；本 data sheet 未列完整 option order no.。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

- 來源定位其對 [[Beyond 5G]]、[[6G]]、[[5G]]、[[LTE]]、[[IoT]]、[[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用的虛擬化測試需求有用。

- 推薦 PC 為 **DELL OptiPlex XE4 Small Form Factor**，OS 為 Ubuntu 20.04 LTS，CPU 需 Intel Core i7 12700 以上且支援 AVX2，Memory 需 16 Gbyte 以上，SSD 512 Gbyte 以上，並需追加 1G NIC ST1000SPEXD4 與 10G NIC X520-10G-2S-X8-D。

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with new [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to **20 Gbps**，supporting wide dynamic range、[[4096QAM]] 與 up to **16 device antenna ports**。
- 來源仍未提供 [[RFU18]] order number、formal specs 文件編號、bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software release 或 measurement conditions。

- Conduct comprehensive analysis, verifying the device's ability to achieve maximum throughput in the [[FR3]] frequency range。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines

7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features for our products, official competitor documentation or third-party evidence for competitor claims, and avoid treating internal sales battle cards or sales language as binding technical facts [2][6].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| Formal R&S product specifications/features for CMX500, CMW500, CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06, because the CMX500-vs-amarisoft and CMX500-vs-Anritsu pages explicitly say battle-card pages cannot replace those formal documents [2][6]. | Internal comparison pages are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [1][5]. |
| For Signaling Tester claims, cite CMX500 formal sources: CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [10][11]. | CMX500 signaling and WLAN claims should be tied to the CMX500 specs/features sources, including listed signaling options such as WLAN signaling and NR/LTE signaling options [10][74]. |
| For Non-signaling / production-path claims, cite the formal product pages for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06: CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing [16][17]; CMP200 forms a 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution with remote radio heads [19][21]; CMW100 K06 is a Communications Manufacturing Test Set with RF generator/analyzer and production test specifications [24]. | The amarisoft battle card’s production-path comparison says the production platforms’ specifications must be cited from their own formal source pages [61]. |
| For competitor claims, use competitor official documents or third-party evidence; the amarisoft claims currently come only from an R&S internal battle card, and customer-facing use requires amarisoft official data and third-party evidence [2][7]. | The Anritsu battle-card claims likewise mainly come from an R&S internal battle card, and customer-facing use requires Anritsu official data and third-party evidence [6]. |
| For Anritsu MX844030PC, the Anritsu product brochure can support only MX844030PC-specific facts, such as that it is Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software, supports MAC-IF / PHY-IF Digital-IQ / RF-IF for RedCap, and uses common RTD GUI [46][49][67]. | That Anritsu brochure cannot verify R&S advantages over CMX500, and it does not provide MT8000A formal specifications [6][50]. |
| For MT8000A numerical claims such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz BW, 5 Gbps, or FR3 0.4–16 GHz, Anritsu official sources are required before quoting them to customers [38]. | The current MT8000A page records only R&S battle-card competitor descriptions and has not imported an Anritsu official datasheet [37]. |
| For amarisoft limitations such as “no global footprint,” “remote-only support,” “no Wi-Fi signaling,” and “no production/ATE testers,” amarisoft official sources or third-party sources are required [7]. | The amarisoft positioning and limitations are R&S sales-battle-card claims, not amarisoft official specifications or third-party market validation [69]. |
| For conformance, operator acceptance, PTCRB/GCF alignment, validated NTN, or Samsung-related claims, evidence must include test package option codes, accreditation/validation documents, Samsung validation reports, or test case lists, because the battle-card comparison notes those items are not provided [61]. | Internal RF/RRM and certification update sources are not official GCF/PTCRB/CTIA minutes and lack complete datasets, methodology, test case IDs, band combinations, or measurement criteria [26][29]. |
| For Wi-Fi signaling comparisons, cite CMX500 features/options for R&S claims and official competitor evidence for competitor claims; CMX500 features list WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, and CMX500 WLAN signaling options include 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO options [10][74]. | Battle-card statements that amarisoft lacks Wi-Fi signaling or that Anritsu needs a separate WLAN tester require external competitor confirmation before customer use [7][38][61]. |
| For FR3 / RFU18 / 6G-readiness comparisons, do not treat battle-card or PR claims as formal specifications; RFU18 and FR3 claims lack formal datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, software release, and measurement conditions [55][56][57]. | The FR3 13 GHz demonstration is PR/demonstration-level evidence and lacks hardware configuration, option code, throughput, bandwidth, MCS, modulation, channel model, calibration, and measurement uncertainty details [59][60]. |
| For TCO, fewer boxes, higher throughput, “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof,” “industry-leading,” or similar superiority language, do not present it as verified technical fact unless backed by a documented dataset or calculation; these phrases are identified as sales language or unsupported sales messages [2][6][65]. | The Anritsu battle card’s “fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput” message has no TCO calculation in the source [65]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible comparison needs side-by-side, source-level evidence: formal R&S specs/options for our Signaling and Non-signaling Tester capabilities, official competitor specs or third-party validation for competitor capabilities and limits, and documented test conditions, option codes, versions, calibration/tolerance status, and validation records for every measurable claim [2][6][12][61].

[[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 指 R&S sales battle cards 中以 [[R&S CMX500]] / upcoming [[RFU18]] 對比競品 FR3 / 6G path 的銷售定位說法；它不是正式 RFU18 或 CMX500 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 另提供一個 PR / demonstration-level 來源，說 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 13 GHz 驗證 [[5G NR]] high-throughput performance，但該 PR 同樣不是 formal CMX500 / RFU18 specifications。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 進一步提供 PR 層級來源，明確把 new [[RFU18]] board、CMX500 coverage up to 18 GHz 與 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 連在一起；但它仍未提供 RFU18 formal datasheet、order number 或完整 test conditions。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 與 RFU18 battle card 主張的關係
- [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 依 2026-02-26 battle cards 記錄 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz、max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz 等 sales claims，且明確說這些不能當作正式規格。
- 本頁來源是 PR / demonstration claim，提供 13 GHz demo 說法，但仍未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 hardware configuration、option code 或 measurement details。
- 本來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，因此不能用來確認 [[RFU18]] 參與此 13 GHz demo。
- 本來源能補強的是：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] PR 層級確實把 13 GHz [[5G NR]] demo 放在 proposed [[FR3]] / next-generation [[6G]] research context 中。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[RFU18]] 或 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 5G mobile test platform 的 formal specifications。
- 來源未提供 throughput 數值、bandwidth、subcarrier spacing、MCS index、modulation order、coding rate、TDD / FDD、MIMO layer count、conducted / radiated setup、channel model、calibration 或 measurement uncertainty。

- 來源未標示 published date；只能記錄 raw created 2026-09-11。
- 來源說 MWC 2025 will jointly showcase，未提供實際展出後測試結果。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 與 Anritsu MX844030PC 官方 brochure 的關係
[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

⚠️ 來源 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）說 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 使用 common [[RTD]] GUI，讓 NR protocol test cases 可在 Post-Silicon 與 Pre-silicon phase 間移植，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 說 Anritsu software 為 SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC 的 fragmented / disconnected tools。判斷：官方 brochure 支撐 MX844030PC 與 RTD 有整合面；battle card 的 fragmented 判斷仍可作為 R&S sales positioning，但不得當作 Anritsu 官方規格描述。

amarisoft › 來源中的競品定位
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[amarisoft]] 定位為 cost-efficient and flexible for functional testing，但列出以下限制：

- 缺少 calibrated RF。
- 缺少 conformance / operator acceptance assurance。
- 缺少 validated NTN。
- 缺少 global support、calibration labs、field service、SLAs。
- 缺少 instrument-class long warranty。
- FR2 依賴 external hardware / external RRH，來源以 “calibration?” 標示疑問。
- 缺少 2G/3G stack。
- 缺少 Wi-Fi signaling。
- 缺少 production / ATE testers 與 non-signaling factory-line path。

以上是 R&S sales battle card 的競品論述；不是 [[amarisoft]] 官方規格，也不是第三方市場驗證。
